Summary Description: Dr. Anindya Maiti's research spans building and analyzing large-scale, reproducible datasets (e.g., MagnetDB) to enable empirical analyses of distribution and dynamics, advancing AI safety and reliability in code generation through systematic studies of package hallucinations and mitigations, and developing governance-oriented frameworks for dataset valuation and stewardship (Dataset Value Taxonomy). His work emphasizes data-centric methodologies, cross-disciplinary applicability, reproducibility, and ethical data sharing while bridging AI, data science, and policy.
